entries.zh: 救苦；救助苦难、拔济苦厄（“救苦救难”之义）。西语词头义为“谋生（contrabajo 一词义不明）”，与汉字义不合，存疑
entries.en: to relieve suffering, save from misery (Buddhist 救苦救难); L: 'to earn one's bread (contrabajo)' — sense mismatch with the hanzi
entries.notes: 西语 contrabajo 与汉字“救苦”义不合，官话栏空，释义以汉字栏为准

entries.zh: 生活计；生计、谋生之道（以某种劳作营生）
entries.en: to earn one's living by some trade or work; livelihood
entries.notes: T99 污損難辨（“活”字声调），字义仍据“生活計”明晰；官话栏空

entries.zh: 抢脚跂（末字原注疑作“跛”）；抢步赶急、急行；西语词头义为“短时内获益”，对应较弱
entries.en: to gain in a short time; hanzi: hurried, tiptoe-stepping — correspondence uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字栏自带 [疑]（跂/跛不定），西语“短时获益”与“抢脚急行”义对合较弱；官话栏空

entries.zh: 添头贴尾；零星添补、两头贴补，积少成多以增益家财
entries.en: to augment one's fortune (capital) by small additions at both ends; to eke out and increase one's wealth

entries.zh: 发财；发财致富、获利息钱
entries.en: to make a fortune, get rich
entries.notes: 西语缩写 ff.o 展开依赖推断（疑 oficio/fruto 类），官话栏空

entries.zh: 鹿角胶；鹿角熬制之胶（入药）。〔西语词头直义为“鹿角之枝叉/钩”，与汉字“胶”义不合，存疑〕
entries.en: gelatin/glue made from deer antler (medicinal); L: 'fork/tine of the deer's antlers' — mismatch
entries.notes: T99，且西语 gancho（枝叉/钩）与“胶”义不合、M 栏四音节对汉字三字（末音 cai 无对应字）；官话栏空

entries.zh: 瓮鼻；说话鼻音重、瓮声瓮气（鼻塞之音）
entries.en: nasal-voiced, one who speaks through the nose

entries.zh: 升；量器、容量单位（即西语 ganta 所对应之米谷量器，菲律宾制约合三公升）
entries.en: sheng, a dry measure for grain/rice, equated with the Philippine ganta (ca. 3 liters)

entries.zh: 官升；官定标准量器（西语注谓其容十 ganta，即十升之斗）
entries.en: the official standard measure, a vessel holding ten gantas (a dou/peck of ten sheng)

entries.zh: 管；管子、小管（西语 gantillas 或为小量器/半 ganta，guazhillo 一词未详，对应存疑）
entries.en: tube, pipe; L: gantillas ('small gantas'?) with guazhillo unresolved
entries.notes: 西语 guazhillo 词未详，gantillas 与“管”的对应依赖推断；官话栏空

entries.zh: 钩；钩子、钩形物（西语 garabato 亦指涂画、花押，此处取“钩”）
entries.en: hook (garabato); also a scrawl or flourish
entries.notes: M 栏第二音 gio 所对汉字未详；官话栏空

entries.zh: 白鹤；鹤/白鹭一类涉禽（西语 garça）
entries.notes: T99 污損難辨（“白”字声调），字义仍据“白鶴”明晰；官话栏空

entries.zh: 喉；喉咙（西语并注另一词 gurguro）
entries.en: throat (garganta; gurguro as a second gloss)
entries.notes: M 栏四音节对汉字一字“喉”，yin/au/co 诸音对应未详；官话栏空
T99 污損難辨（“咽”字声调）；官话栏空

entries.en: under the neck, the front of the throat
entries.notes: T99 污損難辨，且 M 栏四音节对汉字二字，后二音 am chy 对应未详；官话栏空

entries.zh: 喉管；喉咙之管、气管（呼吸之管）
entries.en: the windpipe, throat-pipe (garganta as breathing tube)
entries.notes: M 栏末音 guangezo 所对汉字未详（疑非闽南语音写）；官话栏空
